# Accepted govulncheck findings — Security Gate
#
# Format:  GO-ID  review-by=YYYY-MM-DD  # justification
#
# An entry here means: "we know, and there is nothing to install."
# It does NOT mean "ignore forever" — the gate fails when an entry is past its
# review-by date, and also fails when an entry is no longer reported at all
# (stale allowlist), so this file cannot quietly rot.
#
# Anything NOT listed here fails the gate.
#
# --- currently empty, and that is the intended state ---
#
# It held two entries until 2026-09-06: GO-2026-4887 and GO-2026-4883, both
# Moby/docker with "Fixed in: N/A" — no released version resolved either, as
# re-verified against docker/docker v28.5.2 on 2026-09-03. They were reachable
# only through internal/docker, which used the Docker SDK to read the daemon
# socket directly.
#
# The docker-via-helper feature removed that path entirely: the panel no longer
# talks to Docker at all, and the privileged helper uses net/http over the
# socket instead of the SDK, so github.com/docker/docker and its moby/* and
# opencontainers/* dependencies are gone from go.mod. With the code unreachable,
# govulncheck stops reporting the two findings — which is precisely why the
# entries had to be deleted in the same commit: a listed finding that is no
# longer reported fails this gate as a stale allowlist.
#
# Removing an accepted risk beats renewing its review-by date every six months.
